citation.title: Length Scale Control in Topology Optimization using Fourier Enhanced Neural Networks

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: For the tip cantilever benchmark, Fourier-TOuNN yields lower reported compliance than classical SIMP: 43.39 versus 48.45 at the stated target volume fraction of 0.75.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: §5.1 reports 4–6 s for Fourier-TOuNN and calls this consistent with mesh-based implementations, but gives no paired classical runtime from which to derive a factor.
claim.alternatives: Fig. 9 also gives three other SIMP, TOuNN, Fourier-TOuNN compliance comparisons; §5.1 says learned runs take 4–6 s and are comparable to mesh-based implementations; §5.2 compares length-scale topologies qualitatively.

baseline.hardware_classical: Intel i7-6700 CPU at 2.6 GHz, 16 GB RAM (§5, all experiments)
baseline.hardware_ml: Intel i7-6700 CPU at 2.6 GHz, 16 GB RAM (§5, all experiments)
baseline.problem_size: Default 60 × 30 elements for four Fig. 9 benchmarks (§5.1)
baseline.classical_iterations: Fig. 9 SIMP: 119 for tip cantilever, 92 mid cantilever, 119 MBB, 131 Michell
baseline.ml_time: 4–6 s across the four Fig. 9 examples (§5.1)
baseline.training_time: Per-problem optimization takes 4–6 s across Fig. 9; no offline training (§5.1)
baseline.data_generation_cost: not stated; no offline dataset is used (§4–5)
baseline.quality_metric: Compliance evaluated with FE during optimization (§4, §5.1, Fig. 9)
baseline.quality_gap: Tip cantilever: Fourier-TOuNN J = 43.39 versus SIMP J = 48.45 at target volume fraction 0.75 (§5.1, Fig. 9)

R1.evidence: §5.1 Fig. 9: primary comparison is compliance; no paired speed ratio is reported.

R2.evidence: §5.1 Fig. 9: primary comparison is compliance; no paired speed ratio is reported.

R3.evidence: §4–5: neural weights are optimized separately for each design problem without an offline training dataset.

R4.evidence: §4–5.1: compliance is based on FE calculations during optimization, but actual volume satisfaction and failed-design rates for the final high-resolution outputs are not reported.

reporting.n_test_cases: 4 direct SIMP comparison benchmarks in Fig. 9, with further length-scale and multi-material examples (§5)

notes: Fig. 9 reports FE iterations of 151 for Fourier-TOuNN tip cantilever versus 119 for SIMP, while the qualitative computational-time statement gives only the Fourier-TOuNN range. The preprint's replication statement names public Python code.
